## Appearance

Mrs. Allan possesses clear, bright, and true eyes. Her facial features also include sweet and sudden dimples.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P27](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0027)_

## Personality

Allan is a frank, cheerful, and well-liked young man known for holding high ideals. He possesses a gay, sweet, and sympathetic demeanor, and he is skilled at preaching magnificent sermons that continuously improve.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P3](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0003), [v3 ch.Weddings P46](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0046)_

## History

Before coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mrs. Allan was a self-described mischievous girl who struggled with geometry and was once allowed to attend school for a day with her older sisters at age five. After arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a bride, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea, where she kindly comforted a mortified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl accidentally served a cake flavored with anodyne liniment. She continued to offer comfort and guidance to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the following years, supporting her after [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's death and giving her encouraging advice on teaching, ideals, and friendship. ## Quotes

> “My dear little girl, you mustn’t cry like this,” she said, genuinely disturbed by Anne’s tragic face. “Why, it’s all just a funny mistake that anybody might make.”
>
> — Allan — [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)

> "and we should have a very high ideal of it, and never sully it by any failure in truth and sincerity. I fear the name of friendship is often degraded to a kind of intimacy that has nothing of real friendship in it."
>
> — Allan — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P46](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0046)

> "I hope you’ll have a good time, Anne. You’ve worked very hard this past year and you have succeeded."
>
> — Allan — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P31](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0031)

> “Every little baby is the sweetest and the best,’” quoted Mrs. Allan gaily. “If little Anne had come you’d have felt just the same about her.”
>
> — Allan — [v3 ch.Weddings P45](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0045)

> "I suppose you are looking forward to your vacation, Anne?"
>
> — Allan — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P28](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is a close friend and trusted confidante to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), offering her gentle comfort and encouraging advice throughout her youth and early adulthood. Their friendship begins when Mrs. Allan gracefully forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for accidentally serving her a cake flavored with liniment, choosing to comfort the embarrassed girl and admire her garden instead. Over the years, Mrs. Allan supports [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through major life transitions, helping her process her grief after Matthew's sudden death and advising her on teaching and ideals.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), +20 more_
